sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.7799 Of 2019
Order:

The present criminal petition is filed to quash the proceedings in FIR No.716 of 2019 on the file of Anakapalli (T) Police Station, Visakhapatnam registered for the offences under Sections 307, 353,
270, 273, 328 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code and Section 59(1) of Food Safety Standard Act [for short FSS Act], against the petitioners/Accused No.4 and 6.
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent/State.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on the orders of this Court, passed in Criminal Petition No.6133 of 2019, dated 25.10.2019 and the common order passed in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018 wherein the criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners/accused therein are quashed for the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act holding that "tobacco" products would not fall within the definition of "food", as specified under Section 3(i)(j) of FSS Act, therefore, registration of FIR is not permissible.

4. Relying on the above said orders passed by this Court, the learned counsel for the petitioners urged this Court to quash the proceedings against the petitioners herein, except for the offence punishable under section 307 IPC.
5.

On the other hand, though the Additional Public Prosecutor opposed the relief prayed for,
submitted that he is not in a position to dispute the fact that various petitions filed before this Court under section 482 Cr.P.C. have been allowed and FIRs have been quashed on the basis of analogy put forth by the petitioners before this Court.

6. Considering the aforesaid submissions and in view of the orders of this Court rendered in Criminal Petition Nos. 6133 of 2019, dated 25.10.2019 and Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018, the present criminal petition is allowed in part quashing the proceedings in FIR No.716 of 2019 on the file of Anakapalli (T) Police Station, Visakhapatnam against the petitioners/Accused No.4 and 6, except for the offence punishable under Section 307 of IPC.
As a sequel, all the pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
